label: exsanguinate picture: fighter fields
why: The picture's own state on the fighter (the thread's reach, the flush clock, the cast and hp already seen, the side, the snap); never m.ultFx (open item 25). Read by nothing in the sim.

label: exsanguinate picture: the presentation call
why: tickPresentation runs through hit stops and after the match; one call to tickSiphon.

label: exsanguinate picture: tickSiphon
why: Finds the cast by drainTally.casts rising (the flush clock) and the drain by drainTally.drained rising (a '+n' float per whole hp, the engine's own Match.float, filed here and never in tickStatus); drives the thread's reach off ultDrain && !over && both alive && the foe bleeding, and files the snap at the close (clock, death or verdict). Writes presentation fields and floats only; shellHash, no rng.

label: exsanguinate picture: the thread's call (world, under both balls)
why: World pass under both balls, rim to rim: the thread, its beads and its snap (bloom share 0; nothing inside a shell).

label: exsanguinate picture: the flush's call (world, over both fighters)
why: World pass over both fighters: the cast's 0.25s dark-red flush on her shell (a darkening; the foe's shell cut out when she is b).

label: exsanguinate picture: the drawing methods
why: drawSiphon / drawSiphonTop and one method a component (path, cord, thread + beads, snap).

label: exsanguinate picture: the nova's burst retired
code:
/* ---- EXSANGUINATE'S BURST OF BLADES IS RETIRED WITH THE NOVA (v76; built
       v106): the fang ring, its 300-unit sweep and the threads pulled back
       off the quarry were the nova's. The drain draws off the FIGHTER
       (`drawSiphon`), where the one ultFx slot cannot erase it. */
why: drawUltOver's widowmaker branch was the NOVA's set-piece (14 fangs on a 300-unit ring, the threads pulled back off the quarry); the nova is out (v106 stage 1), so its picture goes too.

label: exsanguinate picture: the ultFx life entry retired to the cast's record
code:
/* EXSANGUINATE (v106) IS NO LONGER A SET-PIECE ON THIS SLOT either.
         Its window is drawn off the fighter (`drawSiphon`, `drawSiphonTop`),
         where the one slot cannot erase it; the burst of blades that read
         this record is retired and its field spec is out, so its entry
         below carries the CAST's record and nothing draws from it -- as
         for Daybreak and Corollary. The number is kept: the record's
         lifetime is the cast's, and changing it would move nothing drawn. */
why: The widowmaker entry in the ultFx life map timed the nova's burst; with the burst and its field spec retired nothing draws from the record, so the entry is annotated as the cast's record only (the Daybreak / Corollary precedent). Comment only: the number (1.3) and every byte of behaviour stay.

label: exsanguinate picture: the banner's spread
why: The banner's clamp reserved 52 a letter for the fan's horizontal throw; the filling letters have none.

label: exsanguinate picture: the banner's letters fill
why: The banner's letters were thrown out of the nova's fan and dripped off at the end (blood leaving); now each letter's red rises in it from the foot, left to right (a level coming up).
